content: मूढ {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [मुह्-क्त] .²1 Stupefied, infatuated; मूढाः शोणितगन्धेन निपेतुर्धरणीतले <ls>Rām. 6. 52. 15</ls>; प्रत्यासन्नविपत्तिमूढमनसां प्रायो मतिः क्षीयते <ls>Pt. 2. 4</ls>. .²2 Perplexed, bewildered, confounded, at a loss; किंकर्तव्यतामूढः ‘being at a loss what to do’; so ह्रीमूढ <ls>Me. 70</ls>. .²3 Foolish, silly, dull, stupid, ignorant; अल्पस्य हेतोर्बहु हातुमिच्छन् विचारमूढः प्रतिभासि मे त्वम् <ls>R. 2. 47</ls>. .²4 Mistaken, erring, deceived, gone astray. .²5 Abortive. .²6 Confounding. .{@-ढः@} A fool, blockhead, dolt, an ignorant person; मूढः परप्रत्ययनेयबुद्धिः <ls>M. 1. 2</ls>. .{@-ढाः@} ({%m.%} <ab>pl.</ab>) An epithet of the elements in the Sāṅkhya philosophy. .{@-ढम्@} confusion of mind.
